args_named.title: Method Study 001D: explanation-testing of the six unmatched unit-day cells (retrospective, corpus 2026-08-04..10)

args_named.statement: Each of the six unmatched unit-day cells identified by Method Study 001C can be fully explained from public period-level information.

args_named.conclusion: CONFIRMED - all six explained by one mechanism: every cell's gap-generating accepted counterparts are dominated by actions NESO excludes from its accepted-side skip-comparison stack (Behind constraint 760..43,752 rows per cell-date, plus System-tagged), corroborated by SO-flagged acceptances in the exact qualifying periods (constraint management on Seagreen/Viking/Edinbane wind, Cruachan/Sloy hydro, Grain CCGT). Our screen made a comparison NESO's methodology declines to make, so no skip is recorded. Deliverable-headroom bounds (0-7 MW for BHOLB-1) and daily-vs-period granularity contribute context; battery state of charge was not needed. The corpus week's unmatched residue is now zero; lesson for 002+: attribution must key operator exclusions on BOTH sides of every comparison.
